posts.title: Tommy Was Here
posts.description: Tommy was here with his leaf blower yesterday and I was soooooooo happy to see him! Mom didn't get that picture because I was moving so fast and ummmmmmm - my lipstick was showing a LOT! His friend, Chris, came too to help Tommy out~ The boys did a fantastic job! posts.title: Nature Friday
posts.description: We are joining Rosy this week for Nature Friday~~ You will not believe this but mom found a Forsythia in bloom! It's November! The temps are still in the 30's when we walk but the sun has been bright and beautiful this week! Birdie!! The Shasta Daisy we found a couple of weeks ago is still blooming away!
